title: How Light Up 7 Helped ZICO Trust Build Brand Credibility Through Strategic Video Content, Generating 3.4 Million+ Views
description: Discover how Light Up 7 helped ZICO Trust build brand credibility through strategic corporate video marketing, generating more than 3.4 million combined views through hero videos, podcast content and digital distribution.

page_content.html_content:
For businesses offering complex or specialised services, building trust begins with helping audiences understand what the brand does and why it matters. Light Up 7 partnered with ZICO Trust to create a strategic corporate video marketing campaign that transformed trust and estate-planning topics into clear, engaging and credible content. Through two hero videos, an educational podcast, social media adaptations and targeted distribution across YouTube and LinkedIn, the campaign generated more than 3.4 million combined video views while strengthening ZICO Trust’s visibility and professional credibility.

The Challenge: Making Trusts Clear and Relatable

Trust and estate planning are important financial-planning tools, but many people perceive them as complicated, highly technical or only relevant to the ultra-wealthy. ZICO Trust needed to communicate its expertise in a way that felt approachable without compromising the professionalism expected of a trusted financial-services brand.

The campaign needed to:

  • Simplify Complex Trust Concepts
  • Address Common Misconceptions
  • Maintain Professional Credibility
  • Build Awareness Across Digital Platforms

The central question was straightforward:

How could ZICO Trust turn specialised knowledge into content people would understand and want to watch?

The Strategy: Building an Educational Video Content Ecosystem

Rather than producing a one-off corporate advertisement, Light Up 7 developed a complete video content strategy built around education, storytelling and long-term content value. The campaign combined high-reach hero videos with deeper podcast content and shorter social media adaptations, giving audiences several ways to discover and understand ZICO Trust.

Hero Videos That Generated 3.4 Million+ Views

The two hero videos formed the foundation of the campaign. Instead of overwhelming audiences with technical terminology, both videos used accessible storytelling and straightforward explanations to introduce trust and estate-planning concepts.

Campaign Video 1: Building Awareness Through Education

Performance Highlights

  • More Than 1.7 Million Views
  • Increased Brand Visibility
  • Clear Educational Storytelling
  • Designed To Build Awareness And Understanding

The video introduced important trust concepts in a format that was informative, approachable and easy to follow.

Campaign Video 2: Strengthening Trust Through Storytelling

Performance Highlights

  • More Than 1.7 Million Views
  • Strong Audience Reach
  • Increased Brand Awareness
  • Supported Continued Digital Engagement

Together, the hero videos achieved more than 3.4 million combined views, showing how effective B2B video marketing can help professional-service brands reach wider audiences.

Making Trusts Clear Through Podcast Content

Alongside the hero videos, Light Up 7 produced a podcast-style educational video titled Making Trusts Clear for Everyday Malaysians.

The podcast gave ZICO Trust a longer-form platform to discuss trust-related topics in a natural and conversational format. It addressed the misconception that trusts are only for the ultra-wealthy while exploring their practical role in estate planning, asset protection, family financial continuity, business succession and legacy planning.

Light Up 7 supported the production through:

  • Content Strategy
  • Storyboarding
  • Video Production
  • Creative Execution
  • Post-Production
  • Social Media Cut-Downs

By translating professional expertise into an accessible conversation, the podcast helped ZICO Trust strengthen its thought leadership content and connect with audiences beyond conventional advertising.

Extending the Campaign Through Adapted Content

To increase the lifespan of the campaign, the hero videos and podcast were adapted into shorter content formats for social media. These cut-downs allowed ZICO Trust to reinforce its key messages, reach different audience segments and create more digital touchpoints without developing every asset from the beginning. Light Up 7 also supported the targeted promotion of selected content across YouTube and LinkedIn. Campaign performance was monitored and optimised regularly to help the videos reach relevant consumer and professional audiences. This integrated approach ensured that each production could continue delivering value across different platforms and stages of the audience journey.

The Campaign Impact

The campaign helped move audiences through three important stages.

Awareness

The hero videos, podcast and shorter social media content increased ZICO Trust’s visibility across YouTube and LinkedIn.

Understanding

Clear storytelling and expert conversations made trust and estate-planning topics easier for audiences to understand.

Trust

Consistent educational messaging strengthened ZICO Trust’s position as a knowledgeable and credible industry voice. The campaign showed that even complex financial topics can achieve significant reach when presented through the right combination of strategy, storytelling and professional production.

Why Strategic Video Content Matters

Many businesses do not struggle because they lack expertise. They struggle because their audiences may not immediately understand the value of that expertise. A strong video marketing strategy bridges this gap by turning specialised information into content that feels clear, useful and relevant.

For professional-service brands, educational content can help build familiarity and credibility before a customer is ready to enquire, compare providers or make a decision. By combining creative storytelling, professional production and platform-appropriate content, businesses can create marketing assets that continue supporting brand awareness over time.

Frequently Asked Questions

What Is Corporate Video Marketing?

Corporate video marketing uses professionally produced videos to explain a company's services, educate its audience and strengthen brand credibility.

How Can Video Marketing Build Brand Awareness?

Strategic video content helps brands reach wider audiences by presenting useful information in a format that is easy to watch, understand and share.

Why Is Educational Content Effective for Professional Services?

Educational content allows professional-service brands to demonstrate their expertise while helping potential customers understand complex topics before making a decision.

What Makes a Successful Video Content Strategy?

A successful video content strategy combines clear objectives, audience insights, strong storytelling, professional production, content adaptation and effective distribution.
